title: Localized Harmonic Perturbation on Layers 6-9
scientific_hypothesis: The top-ranked 18-layer candidate from prior iteration is near a local optimum; applying sinusoidal thickness perturbations specifically to layers 6-9 (which exhibited largest deviation from initialization) will probe objective function curvature and escape shallow local minima.
design_principle: Targeted perturbation of high-sensitivity layers identified from prior iteration deviation analysis, preserving the overall stack topology while exploring local design space curvature.
proposed_topology: 18-layer alternating TiO2/SiO2 stack starting with TiO2 on fused silica substrate, terminated with SiO2
design_variables: thicknesses of all 18 layers with layers 6-9 initialized with harmonic modulation amplitude as optimization parameter
theory_basis: Needle optimization principle for iterative layer adjustment
Local curvature probing via targeted perturbation
expected_advantages: May escape local optimum identified in prior iteration
known_risks: Perturbation amplitude may be insufficient to escape local minimum
May converge to similar solution if landscape is flat
execution_request_english: Optimize an 18-layer TiO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate at 45° incidence. Initialize layer thicknesses as follows in nm: [174.64, 197.98, 183.72, 98.09, 166.23, 298.71, 56.66, 85.03, 215.43, 90.06, 173.07, 225.90, 168.16, 115.01, 205.04, 100.50, 200.69, 107.02]. Apply harmonic perturbation to layers 6-9: thickness_6 = 298.71 * (1 + 0.15*sin(pi*6/10)), thickness_7 = 56.66 * (1 + 0.15*sin(pi*7/10)), thickness_8 = 85.03 * (1 + 0.15*sin(pi*8/10)), thickness_9 = 215.43 * (1 + 0.15*sin(pi*9/10)). Allow all 18 thicknesses to optimize within 50-300nm bounds using gradient-based optimizer. Evaluate reflectance in 450-650nm band and transmittance in 700-1000nm band at 45° incidence for unpolarized light. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 450-650 nm, 700-1000 nm. soft objectives: high reflectance in 450-650 nm; high transmittance in 700-1000 nm; minimized crosstalk between bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 450-650 nm; reflectance in 700-1000 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 24 layers.
revision_reason: Applies feedback directive to probe layers 6-9 with harmonic perturbation based on their large deviation from initialization in prior iteration; repaired to be standalone without route references
